facts: Renderer constructor stores the original canvas and its getContext('2d', {alpha:false}) context at lines 126-127.
makeFloor stores floorWorld/floorKey, creates the floor canvas, assigns world dimensions and creates its default 2D context at lines 440-450.
The original Renderer exposes no stored floor 2D context reference; this diagnostic obtains that already source-created context with getContext('2d') and no options.
nativeActorFrames is a WeakMap, while liveEnemySelection/liveCorpseSelection provide bounded eligible actor sets. They cannot enumerate every other visible baked actor selection.
Native rig models/pending maps and player last.selected are existing public fields. The diagnostic reads these fields only after the pixel-read sequence.

options.readFloor: exact true requests F; default false gives R0/R1/R2 control
options.injected: exact true marks fake/injected caller; never certifies a browser run
options.testAPI: explicit mainWidth/mainHeight/floorWidth/floorHeight permits smaller bounded fake fixtures and always marks injected=true

api.primary: Existing Uint8Array or Uint8ClampedArray R0.data, exact main RGBA length. Wrong type/length returns before renderer/context observation.
sequence: Validate R0 length, original main owner/context.canvas identity, geometry and callable getImageData.
Read R1 immediately; no primary pixel loop, hashing, camera, state or readiness inspection precedes this read.
Compare all R0/R1 components exactly. Any difference ends the sequence without even observing floor properties or attempting R2.
If requested, validate the original cached floor owner/key/world/dimensions, get its existing 2D context without options and read F once.
Read R2 on the same main context, without drawing, ticks, awaits, exports or floor hashing between F and R2.
Compare R0/R2 and R1/R2 exactly, then calculate bounded fingerprints and collect primitive diagnostics.

completion.R2Difference: complete=true, stable=false; all requested pixel reads completed but main repeat differed
completion.failure: Requested unavailable floor, invalid returned RGBA, actual read/metadata exception or detected owner/method/geometry change cannot yield a successful complete report. Thrown null/undefined/0 receive an error entry too.

primitiveEvidence: Exact length, changed components, changed pixels, maximum delta, alpha-component count and changed bounding rectangle for main read comparisons.
Byte length and collision-prone FNV1a32 fingerprints for R0/R1/F/R2; no raw arrays, ImageData, Canvas, context, Game, actor, rig, model, selected, metadata or Promise reference escapes.
Post-sequence main/floor context attributes when supported; fillStyle type/value, alpha, composite, smoothing, filter, shadows and transform. Unsupported attributes are explicitly unavailable.
Main geometry, camera/projection/zoom/dpr, cached floor key/world primitive seed/dimensions/theme/city/mission/palette and asphalt status/presence. No asset source URL is reported.
Bounded native model/pending keys and cached eligible selections. fallbackVisible.complete is always false because non-enumerable WeakMap/public fields cannot prove every visible baked ID.
Current owner/geometry/method identities, existing floor context request count, primitive error stages and cleanup facts.
scopeAndLimitations: This helper is only for the root-controlled, already rendered, original QA-owned Renderer. Cache-key/world presence is source-path evidence for a pre-existing floor context, not a universal authenticity proof against a forged caller.
Native function/prototype observations and getContextAttributes do not establish a rendering backend, GPU execution, GPU readiness or a cause for any pixel difference.
F is a single original floor read. Equal floor fingerprints are not strict full-floor A/A equality; no F2 is read and hash collisions remain possible.
Pixel readback may materialize backing storage and allocates native ImageData buffers. This diagnostic does not claim memory reduction, peak heap/GPU memory, timing improvement or presented FPS.
Canvas state diagnostics are collected after the read sequence. No pre-read state equality, clip/path inspection, deep Game/source snapshot or broad arbitrary Proxy/getter equivalence is claimed.
No source image, Canvas, context state, method descriptor, native model or Game is assigned, wrapped, resized, primed, drawn, loaded, disposed or exported by this helper.
A post-probe PNG export is a separate read/serialization and cannot certify the exact bytes of the caller's R0. Existing R0 arrays remain the authority for whole-arm strict A/A comparison.
